A fragment anchor link is extracted into metadata.links when extract_metadata is true

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_metadata\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Jump to <a href=\"#section\">section</a> below.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
